reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: Gentle enough for sensitive skin but be careful around the eyes. Sun protection seems great to me so far. I’ve been using it for about a month and I have zero complaints.
reviews.zh: 對敏感肌夠晒溫和，但係要小心避開眼周。暫時用落覺得防曬效果幾好。我已經用咗大概一個月，完全冇投訴。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: I love the way this product sits on my skin. It doesn’t irritate me like I have found other sunscreens to. It also does not pill. However the packaging is not the greatest to carry in your bag for reapplication as it tends to spill into the cap when it’s on its side.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支防曬上臉嘅感覺。唔似我之前用過嘅其他防曬咁會刺激皮膚，亦都唔會搓泥。不過個包裝真係唔太方便放入袋仔補搽，因為側放嘅時候容易漏入個蓋度。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: I love the thin and lightest consistency of this sunscreen. Although I have noticed that the SKIN1004 sunscreens break me out. Whenever I use them I notice a deep pimple forming either the day of application or the next day. It seems as if it is pore clogging. I used to love their original sunscreen the centella one and didn’t really have problems with it. I’m not sure if there was a change in the formula. But I have since then started trying out new sunscreens to find my go to. I know that some people don’t have problems with this sunscreen, but if you are acne prone then maybe stay away from this one. It has a slight tea tree scent. No white cast.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支防曬嘅質地，夠薄夠輕。雖然我留意到 SKIN1004 嘅防曬會令我爆瘡。每次用完，無論係當日定第二日，都會見到有深層嘅暗瘡形成，似乎係堵塞毛孔嘅關係。我以前好鍾意佢哋原本嗰支 centella 防曬，嗰支就冇咩問題。唔知係咪改咗配方。但係我之後已經開始試其他防曬，搵緊自己嘅心水。我知有啲人用呢支冇問題，但如果係容易生暗瘡嘅膚質，可能就要避開。帶少少茶樹味。冇泛白。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: I have acne and it was nice on my skin and didn't cause any more breakouts. I will say it was way too dewy for me on my skin. Other than that it was really really good.
reviews.zh: 我有暗瘡，用落對皮膚幾友善，冇令我額外爆瘡。一定要講嘅係，對我嚟講水光感太重咗。除此之外係真係好好用。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: I have finally found a sunscreen that doesn’t have the sunscreen smell! I love the lightweight texture and the healthy glow it gives me after applying, and doesn’t break me out.This sun milk isn’t matte, so individuals with oily skin may not care for it. The bottle size small and narrow and fits perfectly in my purse. I have already purchased 2 more. Love this sun milk.
reviews.zh: 我終於搵到一支冇防曬味嘅防曬！好鍾意佢輕盈嘅質地同埋搽完之後嗰種健康嘅光澤感，亦都唔會令我爆瘡。呢支 sun milk 唔係霧面嘅，所以油性肌嘅人可能未必啱。支裝細細支又修長，啱啱好放入我個袋。我已經再買咗兩支。好鍾意呢支 sun milk。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: Usually use physical sunscreens as chemical ones aren’t sensitive friendly enough but this one didn’t cause too much irritation. Still wouldn’t use daily for my sensitive skin
reviews.zh: 平時都係用物理防曬，因為化學防曬對敏感肌嚟講唔夠溫和，但呢支用落又冇造成太大刺激。不過我自己敏感肌都唔會日日用。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text: It’s very lightweight, spreads easily and absorbs into my skin quickly. It has a matte finish which is nice for oily/combo skin and my face isn’t as oily a few hours after wearing it.
reviews.zh: 質地非常輕盈，好容易推開，仲好快就被皮膚吸收。係霧面妝效，對油性／混合性肌膚嚟講好啱，而且用咗幾個鐘之後塊面都冇咁油。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 50ml
reviews.text:
Texture: The product has a lightweight, milky consistency that spreads easily on the skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky residue.
Finish: It leaves a slightly matte finish, making it suitable for those with oily or combination skin.
White Cast: Despite being a mineral sunscreen, it leaves minimal to no white cast, making it suitable for various skin tones.
The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk is an excellent option for those looking for a lightweight, soothing sunscreen that offers high protection without the heavy feel. It's particularly well-suited for sensitive, oily, and acne-prone skin types due to its calming ingredients and matte finish. If you prefer a sun protection product that doubles as a soothing treatment for your skin, this product is worth considering. However, if you have very dry skin, you might want to layer it with a more hydrating moisturizer.
reviews.zh:
質地：產品係輕盈、奶狀嘅質地，好容易喺皮膚上推開。吸收得快，唔會留低油笠或者黏笠嘅殘留物。
妝效：呈現少少霧面效果，適合油性或混合性肌膚。
泛白：雖然係礦物防曬，但幾乎唔會泛白，適合各種膚色。
SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Soothing Sun Milk 對想搵一支輕盈、舒緩型防曬嘅人嚟講係一個好好嘅選擇，提供高防護之餘又唔會有厚重嘅感覺。憑住佢舒緩成分同霧面妝效，特別適合敏感肌、油性肌同容易生暗瘡嘅膚質。如果你鍾意一支防曆兼備舒緩效果嘅產品，呢支值得考慮。不過如果你係極乾性肌，可能要搭配多一層保濕乳。
